title: "Quick Start"
format: html
---

This guide gets BergAgents installed and running on your local machine.

## 1. Prerequisites

- **Python 3.12+**
- **`uv`** (recommended) or `pip`
- **An OpenAI-compatible provider** - e.g. Ollama running locally with a pulled model:

  ```bash
  ollama pull qwen3.5:9b
  ```

## 2. Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-username/berg-agents.git
cd berg-agents

uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
```

## 3. Configuration

Copy the example config and point it at your provider:

```bash
cp config/bergagents.jsonc config/bergagents.local.jsonc
```

Minimal `providers` block (Ollama):

```jsonc
{
  "providers": {
    "ollama": {
      "options": { "baseURL": "http://localhost:11434/v1", "apiKey": "" },
      "models": { "qwen3.5:9b": {} }
    }
  }
}
```

Secrets go in `.env` and are referenced as `${env:VAR_NAME}`:

```dotenv
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
```

Full reference: [Configuration](CONFIGURATION.qmd).

## 4. Run it

Interactive terminal UI:

```bash
python -m berg_agents --tui
# harness> /help
# harness> /harness refactor the login flow to use sessions
```

Web UI (FastAPI serves API + static UI on one origin):

```bash
python -m berg_agents --web --port 8001
# → http://127.0.0.1:8001
```

Python API:

```python
from berg_agents.app import BergAgentsApp

app = BergAgentsApp.create()
result = app.execute("Add retry logic to the sync worker", task_type="standard")
print(result["status"])  # completed | needs_human_review | failed
```
